why.sub: A founder's letter — why we're building this, and why now.
why.p1: Google decides what you find. OpenAI decides what you read. A handful of companies control the gateway to humanity's collective knowledge. When they change their terms, censor results, or shut down — you have no alternative. You accept it, because there is nothing else.
why.p2: Millions of GPUs around the world sit idle 90% of the time. When they do run, they run proof-of-work hash puzzles — burning electricity to produce a number that secures a ledger and produces nothing else. The energy is spent. The output evaporates. Nothing permanent is created.
why.p3: Closed AI models are black boxes. You don't know what they learned, what they store, who controls them, or what happens when their terms change. You trust a company logo. That is not safety — that is hope.
why.p4: Public corpora — Wikipedia, arXiv, Common Crawl, Gutenberg, legal records — are processed by volunteer computers into verified vector embeddings. These embeddings form a single, searchable intelligence index that lives across thousands of machines. No central server. No single point of failure. No gatekeeper.
why.p5: The same GPU that would burn electricity on hash puzzles instead performs embedding work — converting public text into permanent, searchable mathematical form. The energy is spent. The output
why.p6: The entire pipeline — parsing, embedding, quantization, indexing, verification — is inspectable code. Every corpus, every license, every data source is publicly listed. You can fork the brain. Build your own. Change the rules. That is the point.
why.p7: NEMES-X is not a chatbot. It is not a language model. It is not a replacement for ChatGPT.
why.p8c: — built by the people, hosted by the people, owned by no one. When a language model is integrated (planned), NEMES-X provides the context. The LLM writes the answer. But the knowledge — the verified, searchable, permanent index — belongs to the network.
why.p9: We will not pretend this is fully decentralized when it is not. The data layer is peer-to-peer. The governance layer is controlled by the founding authority — signed epochs, capped at 24 hours, with the power to pause or throttle the network.
why.p10: This is not a bug. It is a design choice. Fully permissionless networks are open to spam, sybil attacks, and abuse. An anonymous but cryptographically signed authority provides discipline without identity. If the authority key disappears, the network halts by design — a dead god cannot silently rule.
why.q1: "We call this the Sovereign Network model: P2P at the data layer, constitutional monarchy at the governance layer. The code is open to fork — the network, the data, the constitution. If you want a different ruler, build one."
why.p11: This is not a whitepaper. This is not a promise. This is running code.
why.l1d: — parsed, chunked, and stored in the core corpus (cc100-tr)
why.l4d: — Wikipedia (11 languages), arXiv, WikiHow, Tatoeba, sibling projects
why.l5d: — newscrawl, Gutenberg, Common Crawl WET, ParaCrawl, Caselaw
why.l6d: — Terms, Privacy Policy, DMCA — live on this site
why.p12: The core pipeline is live and running. The cc100-tr mega corpus (109.3M documents) has been embedded. Next: newscrawl, books, and web corpora — then the FAISS index layer is finalized and the unified search interface goes live.
why.p13: Then: the miner client. One-click install. Your GPU joins the network. Your verified contributions earn shares. Weekly settlements in USDT. Premium hosted search for those who prefer not to run their own infrastructure.
why.p14: Then: the sovereign ledger. Signed epoch chain. Anonymous authority. P2P gossip. The full decentralization stack.
why.p15: Because the window is closing. AI companies are consolidating. Access is being gated. Prices are rising. Open alternatives are being squeezed out of the conversation.
why.p16: If we don't build a distributed, transparent, censorship-resistant knowledge infrastructure now — we may not get another chance.
why.p17: This is not a get-rich-quick scheme. This is not a token sale. This is infrastructure.
why.q2: "Information is the oxygen of the modern age. It seeps through walls topped by barbed wire. It courses through wires. It slips through the ether."

miner.title: Mine Knowledge. Not Hashes.
miner.eco: An Antminer S19 Pro burns 3,250W at 75dB and lost about $3.47/day in August 2026 — it heats your room and empties your wallet. A NEMES miner uses 60–240W silently and turns the same socket into verified knowledge vectors that accumulate shares. Electricity becomes knowledge, not heat.
miner.t1d: Parsing + light embedding + audit votes. ~65–100W. Multiplier K=0.5. No model download needed.
miner.t2d: Embedding + 7B chat node. Models: Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B (Q4_K_M GGUF from HuggingFace). ~170–200W. Multiplier K=1.0.
miner.t3d: Embedding + 30B RAG node. Models: Qwen2.5-32B GGUF. ~350–450W. Multiplier K=2.0.
miner.t4d: 70B fine-tuning + inference up to 200B parameters. Models: Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen2.5-72B. Cheaper than a new Antminer, 1/13th the power. Multiplier K=5.0.
miner.t5d: Flagship open models: DeepSeek-V3 (671B MoE) and Kimi-K2 (1T MoE) via vLLM/SGLang on H100-class hardware. Teacher nodes for distillation. Multiplier K=10. Practical shortcut: R1-Distill-32B/70B on Tier 3–4.
miner.earn: Shares = verified vectors × tier multiplier. 20 proofs = 1 batch (0.002 NEMES base, halving every 5M batches). Pool = 50% of network revenue, split by shares. No minimum, dust accumulates. Phase 1: shares accumulate on ledger. Phase 2: cash payout from treasury + enterprise revenue. Nothing here is financial advice.
miner.st1: 1. Download the signed client above and verify its SHA256.
miner.st2: 2. Create a key (nemes-miner keygen), optionally pledge storage (nemes-miner keygen --storage). No root needed.
miner.st3: 3. Run: nemes-miner mine --simple --komuta https://komuta.nemes-x.space --corpus tr. Ctrl+C stops gracefully — your shares stay on the ledger.
miner.sec: Miners see only blind micro-batches (salted IDs, no corpus names). Canary trap texts catch leakers: proven leaks mean ban + forfeited shares. Unplugging is always free — only proven cheating is destroyed. Full spec: Security Architecture.
